# 📥 FORZA HORIZON 6 — ANKER UPDATES (V375+)

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🌐 Always Get The Latest Files Here
Anker tracks new versions faster than this guide can — check here first:
**https://ankergames.net/game/forza-horizon-6**

Currently hosted there:
- **Direct V382.893** — full game
- **Update Only 375.327 → 379.939** (2.4 GB)
- **Update Only 379.939 → 382.893** (1.4 GB)
- **Online Fix**

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Apply Update 375.327 → 379.939
1. Extract the **Update Only** zip into a folder **excluded from Windows Security** — do **not** extract directly into the Forza Horizon 6 folder.
2. Move `!Delete old files.bat` from the update folder into your Forza Horizon 6 folder (where `ForzaHorizon6.exe` is).
3. Run `!Delete old files.bat` **as Administrator**.
4. Copy the remaining update files into the Forza Horizon 6 folder — **replace** files when prompted.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Apply Update 379.939 → 382.893
1. Download and extract the **Update Only** zip into an antivirus-excluded folder.
2. Copy its contents into your main game folder — **replace** files when prompted.
   -# If you're not asked to replace anything, something went wrong.

> ⚠️ This update uses the **RUNE** patch (offline). If you want to play online, apply this update first, then apply the **Online Fix** on top.
> RUNE is currently the more reliable option — Online Fix admins are on break and their patch hasn't kept pace, so it may crash.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 📢 Stay Current
File names and versions shift often — always double-check **[ankergames.net](https://ankergames.net/game/forza-horizon-6)** before downloading.
